description: Source code for 'sstrip', a utility that trims non-essential parts from ELF executable files, including removing trailing zero bytes and section headers, with support for different ELF classes and endianness.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Handles error messages, prints to stderr, returns FALSE.

methods.name: readelfheader32
methods.description: Reads ELF header for 32-bit ELF files and verifies format.

methods.name: readphdrtable32
methods.description: Loads program header table for 32-bit ELF files.

methods.name: getmemorysize32
methods.description: Calculates the memory size of the ELF file based on program headers for 32-bit.

methods.name: modifyheaders32
methods.description: Removes section header references and adjusts program headers for 32-bit ELF.

methods.name: commitchanges32
methods.description: Writes modified headers back to file and truncates file for 32-bit ELF.

methods.name: readelfheader64
methods.description: Reads ELF header for 64-bit ELF files and verifies format.

methods.name: readphdrtable64
methods.description: Loads program header table for 64-bit ELF files.

methods.name: getmemorysize64
methods.description: Calculates the memory size of the ELF file based on program headers for 64-bit.

methods.name: modifyheaders64
methods.description: Removes section header references and adjusts program headers for 64-bit ELF.

methods.name: commitchanges64
methods.description: Writes modified headers back to file and truncates file for 64-bit ELF.

methods.name: truncatezeros
methods.description: Removes trailing zero bytes from the end of the ELF file.
